name: Ida
source:
The sex slave version of Ida that appears in the fully IQ reduced ending of Holly Smiles at The End. 

She has had Jörgen's name tattooed on her ass. Jörgen has given her the sex slave name of Butt Girl.

Her age is unknown as it is not specified how much time has passed since the year 2022 in the Fictional Story visual novel. 

In this game, she has fully summited to Jörgen, as his sex slave, after he has corrupted her during the prior events of Fictional Story.

Thus her sexual slavery in this game is consensual.

[spoiler]The game also confirms, in the full loss of IQ ending, that Fredrik is now Ida's fiancée. She  has already had one of Jörgen's children and Jörgen has just recently impregnated Ida for the second time. Fredrik is unaware that both of the children are not his.[spoiler]
